summary: Skier-triggered large wet-slab avalanche on a southern aspect above treeline at ~12,200 ft on Red Mountain Pass buried US 550 under 12-15 ft of debris; two caught skiers sustained minor injuries, no deaths; CAIC rated it R3/D3; unusually warm weather cited as the trigger factor
location: Red Mountain Pass / US 550 near Silverton
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE — the SnowBrains account is internally inconsistent (gives February 13 in the lead, 'mid-day February 16' later); the KVNF regional newscast at 8:01 AM on Feb 16 already reported it, so Feb 13 (Saturday) is the best pin. SAR agencies unnamed in source; CDOT cleared the highway with heavy machinery.
